configuration: Captured MX2 board initialization: inspect generated/hal/mx_system.c and mx_rcc.c for system clock, interrupt and peripheral initialization.
The captured base initializes board GPIO and USART2; it does not configure arbitrary timer/DMA/peripheral combinations.
main.c is an idle system-initialization entry point. It contains no UART-command, temperature, timer, DMA or middleware application.
Copied SDK files are available for source edits and integration; their presence does not imply enabled peripherals or linked inclusion.
